T: Pancakes first. Then the end of the world.
D: A demon raised by humans works for a secret bureau fighting the supernatural.
P: Serve dessert when Hellboy shares milk and cookies with the kid on the rooftop.
S: young Hellboy and his love of pancakes

Small fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked high with melting butter and maple syrup, with crisp bacon rashers alongside. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs, 400ml buttermilk and 30g melted butter into a thick batter. Fry 3 tbsp at a time in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden, making about 16. Keep warm in a low oven. Fry 12 bacon rashers until crisp. Stack the pancakes with butter, pour over maple syrup and serve the bacon on the side.
Boiled eggs with a Dijon, mayo and dill yolk filling
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks mashed with mayo, mustard and dill, piped back in with a pinch of paprika.
Crisp baked wings glazed with honey, soy and red chilli
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a fiery red chilli and honey glaze.
M: Beetroot, cabbage, carrot and potato soup in beef stock, with dill
Beetroot, cabbage, carrot and potato simmered in beef stock with dill, served with sour cream and rye bread.
the agents of the Bureau for Paranormal Research

Grilled beef franks in soft buns under thick beef and bean chilli, melted cheddar, diced onion and a stripe of mustard. Brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 400g crushed tomatoes and a drained can of kidney beans, and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Grill 8 beef frankfurts for 6 minutes. Toast 8 hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over the chilli and top with 150g grated cheddar, diced onion and mustard.
W: Rooftop brown butter choc chip cookies
Chocolate chip cookies made with browned butter

Big chewy cookies made with nutty brown butter, chunks of dark chocolate and sea salt flakes, served warm off the tray. Melt 150g butter and cook until golden brown and nutty, then cool 10 minutes. Beat with 150g brown sugar, 80g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Stir in 250g plain flour and 1/2 tsp bicarb soda, then 200g chopped dark chocolate. Chill 30 minutes. Roll into 16 balls, bake at 180C for 10 minutes until golden at the edges but soft in the middle, and sprinkle with sea salt.
K: Strawberries blended with milk, malt powder and vanilla ice cream

Ice-cold milk blended with fresh strawberries, malt powder and a scoop of vanilla ice cream, frothy and pink, made for dunking cookies. Hull 250g strawberries and put in a blender with 800ml cold milk, 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 2 tbsp honey and 2 scoops of vanilla ice cream. Blend for 30 seconds until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses and top each with a halved strawberry. Serve straight away alongside the warm cookies.

steps.text: Boil the eggs, cool and peel.
Halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, Dijon and dill until smooth.
Pipe back into the whites and finish with paprika and a sprig of dill.
Warm the butter with honey, soy sauce and chilli until sticky and toss the wings through until glossy.
Simmer the vegetables in the stock until tender.
Serve in bowls with sour cream.

dishes.n: Rooftop brown butter choc chip cookies

steps.text: Brown the butter until nutty, then cool.
Beat with both sugars, the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, bicarb soda and chocolate, then chill.
Roll into sixteen balls and bake at 180C until golden at the edges but soft in the middle.
Blend the strawberries, milk, malted milk powder, honey and ice cream until smooth and frothy.
Pour into chilled tall glasses and top each with a halved strawberry.

s.note: Boiled eggs with a Dijon, mayo and dill yolk filling
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, a spoon of Dijon and chopped dill until smooth. Pipe back into the whites and finish with a pinch of smoked paprika and a tiny sprig of dill on each.

s.note: Crisp baked wings glazed with honey, soy and red chilli
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy sauce and 2 finely chopped red chillies until sticky. Toss the wings through the glaze until glossy and red.

m.note: Beetroot, cabbage, carrot and potato soup in beef stock, with dill
m.how: Grate 3 beetroot, 2 carrots and shred a quarter cabbage. Simmer with 400g diced potatoes in 1.5L beef stock for 40 minutes until tender. Season with dill and a splash of vinegar. Serve in bowls with sour cream and dark rye bread.
